The actual failure occurs at Turn 15 where WebSurfer queries 'MacroTrends' instead of the required 'Google Finance'. The analysis confuses the procedural error (wrong speaker assignment/thought loop) with the data source failure, and misidentifies the specific turn causing the specification violation as the thought turn rather than the action turn (15) where the wrong site was accessed.
